core_obligations: Compactification construction: at a finite level the morphism sits in a proper closure; the limit of the compactifications is a compactification of the limit morphism (properness descends along the limit by the chapter's properness lemmas).
Valuative criterion for the closure: a valued point of the dense open extends into the closure; the extension lifts past the limit because proper limits of affine schemes handle the valued point.
Uniqueness/existence split: two extensions agree on the dense open, hence everywhere; existence is the lift just constructed.
proof_roadmap: Build the compactification as a limit of finite-level compactifications.
Extend the valued point into the closure via the valuative criterion at finite level.
Uniqueness from density; existence from the lift.
difficulty_reason: Constructs a compactification of the limit morphism from finite-level data, applies the valuative criterion to the proper closure, and splits uniqueness/existence. Multi-lemma assembly with an honest construction step.

compared.difference: The sibling is the valuative SEPARATION criterion over Noetherian DVRs with a Krull-Akizuki construction; this lemma is the refined valuative criterion along limits with a compactification construction. Different statements.
